definitions.explanation: A group of people traveling or acting together as a unit, often a delegation or the people accompanying a central figure.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}{一行|いっこう}が{到着|とうちゃく}した。
{一行|いっこう}はバスで{観光地|かんこうち}へ{向|む}かった。
examples.english: The group headed for the sightseeing spot by bus.

examples.japanese: {視察団|しさつだん}の{一行|いっこう}は{各地|かくち}の{工場|こうじょう}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: The inspection delegation visited factories in various regions.

notes:
Counts a group moving as a unit, often with a leader: {名前|なまえ}＋{一行|いっこう} ({社長|しゃちょう}{一行|いっこう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一行|いっこう}{様|さま}: "your party" (polite, on reservations)
- {一行|いっこう}{六名|ろくめい}: a party of six

NOTE ON READING:
Read いっこう in this "group" sense. The same kanji read いちぎょう means "one line (of text)."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {団体|だんたい}: group; party — larger and more organized
- {一団|いちだん}: a body of people — emphasizes a single cluster
